evidence.title: UC SAREP · Oat profile
evidence.use: Broad California sowing months (October–January), cold exposure reference, and cover/forage uses. The profile draws on older literature; local cultivar and farm review are required.

evidence.title: UC ANR · Cover Cropping Considerations in California Annual Crop Rotations (2024)
evidence.use: General 10–30-day transition guidance for cover crop termination. The 20-day setting is an editable planning assumption within that range, not a species-specific requirement.

limitations: No validated growth-duration or forage harvest-stage model. No farm-specific water balance, soil assessment, pest screen, or yield prediction. Species example is not locally field-validated. The two alternatives compare management of the same species, not two different species.
